question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"enough."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Enough"** means sufficient or adequate. (पर्याप्त, काफ़ी, जितना (मात्रा या संख्‍या) आवश्‍यक हो उतना) • **Example:** *I have **enough**__ instruments.* • It is used to indicate that there is a satisfactory amount or degree of something. • In this context, it is indicating that there is a sufficient amount of something to perform a certain action. • The correct answer is option 1. • **Correct passage:** When he was in college, a famous poet made a useful distinction for him. He had drunk __**enough**__ in the poet's company to be compelled to describe to him a poem he was ______ (2) ______ of. It would be a monologue of sorts, the self-contemplation of a student on a summer afternoon who is reading Euphuise. The poem itself would be a subtle ______ (3) ______ of euphuisms, translating the heat, the day, the student's concerns, into symmetrical posies; translating even his ______ (4) ______ and boredom with that famously foolish book into a euphuism. The poet nodded his big head in a sympathetic, rhythmic way as this was ______ (5) ______ to him, then told him that there are two kinds of poems. There is the kind you write; there is the kind you talk about in bars. Both kinds have value and both are poems; but it's fatal to confuse them. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Many" **means a large number or amount. (लोगों या वस्‍तुओं की बड़ी संख्‍या, बहुत सारे, अनेक) • **"Far"** means at a considerable distance. (बहुत दूर; दूरस्‍थ) • **"Since" **means from a particular time or event in the past until now. (अतीत में विशिष्‍ट समय-बिंदु से (अतीत में ही) बाद के किसी बिंदु तक या (वर्तमान में) अभी तक; तब से अब तक) 48:Ta8c, The correct answer is **"thinking."**
